findings.title: Missing backend ownership check
findings.description: CaseEditModal updates cases without confirming the case belongs to the current user. Relies entirely on backend authorization middleware. If backend doesn't enforce ownership, any authenticated user could edit any case.
findings.recommendation: Verify backend enforces requireCaseOwnership middleware. Add frontend-side assertion before edit is allowed.

findings.title: Unified endpoint assumes backend support
findings.description: approveProfile and rejectProfile both call PATCH /status endpoint. If backend only has /approve and /decline routes, both operations will 404. No fallback or version detection exists.
findings.recommendation: Verify backend has PATCH /matrimonial/profiles/{id}/status endpoint before deploying. If not, implement fallback to POST /approve and POST /decline routes.

findings.title: Token logging reduction is incomplete
findings.description: Removed console.log of token substring from frontend, but this assumes server-side logging doesn't persist credentials. Backend OAuth/auth endpoint may still log tokens. Frontend fix alone is insufficient for full credential security.
findings.recommendation: Audit backend logging for all auth endpoints (/auth/login, /auth/google, /auth/refresh). Ensure no tokens are logged server-side.

findings.title: GSI button retry logic may mask configuration errors
findings.description: When button fails to initialize, code retries after 200ms timeout. If NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is missing or invalid, retry will also fail silently and user sees blank space instead of error message.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit error message or warning if GSI initialization fails after retry. Log to console or show UI alert to admin.

findings.title: Admin dashboard partial failure is silent
findings.description: Promise.allSettled masks which API endpoint failed. If cases load but leads fail, admin sees incomplete data with no indication of the problem.
findings.recommendation: Add visual indicators (warning badges, error messages) for failed endpoints in admin dashboard UI.

findings.title: Race condition potential in concurrent case edits
findings.description: If client submits case edit while another edit is in-flight, the re-fetch after first edit completes may override in-flight changes. No optimistic locking or server-side conflict detection.
findings.recommendation: Add server-side conflict detection or implement optimistic locking with version/timestamp validation.
